mapper.select: SELECT bottleneck.start_time_seconds, bottleneck.end_time_seconds, bottleneck.geometry FROM detected_bottlenecks bottleneck JOIN simulation_results result ON result.id = bottleneck.simulation_result_id WHERE result.simulation_id = #{simulationId} ORDER BY bottleneck.bottleneck_order ASC

SELECT heatmap.chunk_sequence, heatmap.density_data FROM heatmaps heatmap JOIN simulation_results result ON result.id = heatmap.simulation_result_id WHERE result.simulation_id = #{simulationId} ORDER BY heatmap.chunk_sequence ASC
